lede: Thanksgiving is the main event this week — the Turkey Trot kicks off Thursday morning, Alloy Kitchen is hosting an Outlaw Thanksgiving, and there's live music at Mountain Lodge if you need somewhere to land. The library has a movie matinee and Radio Biblioteca on Wednesday for folks easing into the holiday, and the weekend stretches out with Will Ski 4 Food, free open skate, and Mind Blown for those sticking around after the feast.
